provenance: Synthetic design review; invented constraints, estimates and targets; no company ownership or outcomes
problem: Three product teams need account-safe one-shot reads during a transport transition; platform internals differ
staffScope: One iOS consumer seam, deterministic ownership/error fixtures, installation and rollback rehearsal
principalScope: Cross-team product contract, sequence and funding, adoption exceptions, long-lived compatibility and deprecation accountability
constraints: Unknown device and artifact evidence stays pending

options.choice: Keep local adapters and publish shared contract fixtures
options.tradeoff: Least adoption disruption; continued duplicated implementation and review

options.choice: Shared behavior contract with native platform adapters and staged adoption
options.tradeoff: Common invariants and evidence; adapter maintenance and migration effort remain

options.choice: One shared execution engine across platforms
options.tradeoff: Potential code reuse; new interoperability, lifecycle, tooling and deployment coupling

recommendation: Provisionally test contract option with one read consumer on each platform; reject expansion if ownership/cancellation parity or meaningful cost improvement is absent
costInterpretation: Planning estimates only, not measured savings; include feature opportunity cost, parallel maintenance, support, training and corrective delivery

owners.accountableFor: Decision contract, funding, exception ledger and debt deadline
Credential/session seam, cancellation and final-commit fixtures
Native coroutine/transport behavior under the common product contract
Adoption plans, selection continuity and user-visible failure behavior
Authorization, backwards-compatible responses and write reconciliation
Installed cohorts, artifact evidence, comparable metrics and stop authority

stages.gate: Independent full-value and error/ownership fixtures for existing adapters
One read consumer per platform, ordinary review, documented exceptions
stages.evidence: Pending artifact and representative interaction results

stages.gate: No contract regression; comparable task outcomes; maintenance cost reviewed
stages.evidence: Pending denominator, time window and cohort dashboard

stages.gate: Supported consumers migrated or documented exception; old resources drained; installed clients and services compatible
stages.evidence: Pending signed retirement decision and reconstruction ledger

rollback: Select the existing adapter for future reads where the installed binary honors that selection; retain the chosen adapter for active requests; do not replay ambiguous writes or promise a binary downgrade
rejectedExperiment: Retire the candidate and temporary selection after restoring the supported old contract

deprecation.rule: Date prompts review, never automatic removal; require adoption/recovery evidence and budget for exceptions

metrics.denominator: Eligible consumers, split by team and platform
metrics.target: Synthetic proposal: all pilot consumers pass before a second wave
Zero stale commits in executed contract fixtures

metrics.denominator: Attempted reads in matching build/cohort/time window, including failures
metrics.target: No agreed guardrail regression; actual budget remains pending

metrics.denominator: Adapter maintenance, incident and onboarding hours in a declared review window
metrics.target: Compare observed cost with the planning estimate before expansion

critique: Can another team implement the contract without inheriting the same runtime?
Who absorbs adoption cost and owns exceptions?
Which installed clients cannot honor rollback?
Does successful retirement remove the old path rather than the adopted replacement?
Are measured, estimated and pending claims distinct?
